role: Base world-core fuzz probe (kind setblock): random World.setBlock ops on a raw region with the 3x3 chunk hash after each, checked op by op by the native height map and light code; also dispatches the move (Move, ProbeEntity) and feature (FeatureProbe) kinds. Owns Probe.rawChunks, which makes ChunkProviderServer.loadChunk skip populateChunk, and the chunk hash/serialization helpers most other probes reuse.
notes: Runs on its own thread (the OTHER entity-ID role). Output ops.bin, final.bin.gz, manifest.json. csrc/engine/world.c, snapshot.c and render_blocks.h cite its layouts. lane/keyframes: fillChunkTail (the height maps, heightMapMinimum and the section mask) split out of fillChunkBytes for Snapshot.fillChunkBytes.
